title.zh: 获取存储空间的合规保留策略信息
title.en: Query the data retention policy information of a bucket

descriptions.zh:
对象存储OSS支持WORM（Write Once Read Many）特性，允许您以不可删除、不可篡改的方式保存和使用数据。OSS允许针对Bucket设置基于时间的合规保留策略，保护周期为1天到70年。
当合规保留策略锁定后，您可以在Bucket中上传和读取文件（Object），但是在Object的保留时间到期之前，不允许删除Object及合规保留策略。Object的保留时间到期后，才可以删除Object。 > 若指定用来获取Bucket的合规保留策略信息对应的WORM ID不存在，则返回404。
descriptions.en:
Object Storage Service (OSS) supports the Write Once Read Many (WORM) feature, which allows you to store and use data in a non-deletable and non-modifiable manner. OSS allows you to configure a time-based retention policy for a bucket. The protection period ranges from 1 day to 70 years.
After a retention policy is locked, you can upload and read objects in the bucket. However, you cannot delete objects or data retention policy before the retention period of the objects expires. You can delete objects only after their retention period expires. > If the WORM ID specified for querying data retention policy of the bucket does not exist, 404 is returned.
